name: R.S.P.
source:
This VN tells a story about a young boy whose father suddenly moved into another town.
So, he's transferred into new school. And as a young boy, he got bored fast by the small town life, until he met one girl who introduced him into RSP club. From here, play it yourself.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=30&t=6872]Lemma Soft forums[/url]]
translation:
本作讲述一名少年随父亲突然搬到另一座城镇的故事。
他因此转入一所新学校。作为一个年轻男孩，他很快便厌倦了小镇生活，直到遇见一名女孩，对方带他加入RSP社。之后的故事，就请亲自游玩吧。

[摘自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=30&t=6872]Lemma Soft forums[/url]]
